# Sol Next 9.0.1 (Build 901 · Dawn Orbit · Public Edition · Apache-2.0)

> **Sol Next 9.0.1 ("Dawn Orbit / 晨曦轨道")** (`ai.sol.next`, Build 901) is a voice-first, zero-learning-curve Android 10–16 (API 29–36, 16KB page-aligned) AI Mobile Agent with **100% zero built-in API keys (Universal BYOK)**, paying tribute to pioneer project [**`wangzan101/Mika`**](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika) (Apache-2.0).

## Key 9.0.1 Breakthroughs

1. **Unified 4-Screen "Dawn Orbit" Voice-First UI + New 3D Ringed-Planet Logo**:
   - Screen 1 (`首页 · 语音交互`): Full-bleed Dawn Orbit voice canvas, zero text input box, glowing 5-bar waveform orb, `∞` full-duplex continuous toggle, `○○/○○` capability grid.
   - Screen 2 (`任务执行`): Clean frosted progress bar, multi-state green/blue step tree with 100% humanized natural-language sub-steps (zero package names, zero node IDs, zero pixel coordinates), Android 17 Generative UI interactive cards, and chronological timeline.
   - Screen 3 (`AI 通话`): Misty Dawn Orbit call orb, 35-bar live speech spectrum, ticking duration timer, frosted live speech transcript bubble, `<0.1ms` on-device Scam Shield (`SolCallScamShield`), 1-tap Live Whisper steering, and Mute/End/Speaker controls.
   - Screen 4 (`设置 · 模型配置 BYOK`): 3-row universal cloud model config (Provider / API / Model), Privacy & Security toggles (on-device Privacy Firewall ON by default, usage telemetry OFF by default), Permissions & Auto-OTA About panel.
2. **Full-Duplex Real-Time Voice Agent (`SolLiveVoiceEngine`)**: Hardware DSP (`AEC + NS + AGC`), `<20ms` barge-in interruption, `<400ms` conversational replies, and automatic dispatching of actionable device/game/call commands.
3. **Google Android 16 / 17 AI OS Roadmap Shipped Today**:
   - Android 17 **Generative UI** (`SolGenerativeUiSpec`, 0-token device dashboards + `ui_render_card`).
   - Android 16/17 **Magic Cue** (`SolMagicCueEngine`, `<0.1ms` OTP copy, parcel lookup, hotline call, navigation, low-battery whispers).
   - Android 16 **AppFunctions** (`SolAppFunctionBridge`) + **Live Updates** (`Notification.ProgressStyle`).
   - **On-Device Private Compute Privacy Firewall** (`SolPrivacyRedactor`): masks national IDs, Luhn bank cards, API keys, and passwords locally before cloud LLM calls.
4. **Human-Like Real-Time Gaming**: 4-finger simultaneous `multi_touch` (joystick + skills/aim), burst `ui_tap_sequence`, bottom-row card/button OCR, and 60Hz `realtime_play`.
5. **Universal Any-Cloud-Model BYOK + Autonomous OTA**: Zero local GPU servers required; auto-learns capabilities for OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, Qwen-VL, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; text-only models auto-accelerate with on-device ML Kit OCR; startup + 6h automatic OTA checks with push notifications and Wi-Fi pre-download.

## Verified Android 16 (API 36 · 16KB) Benchmarks

- **0-Token Android 17 Generative UI Dashboard**: Instant native Compose KPI card (battery, storage, RAM, Wi-Fi).
- **Complex Multi-Step Verification & Restore (`Dark theme OFF -> ON -> OFF`)**: `9.3 s` · `4/4` verified + native Generative UI report.
- **Dou Dizhu 3-Round Landscape Zero-A11y**: `32.5 s` · `10 steps` · `3/3` rounds won.
- **DroidFish Stockfish Chess + Ungranted Android 16 Permission**: Auto-allowed `PermissionController` + played legal Sicilian opening.
- **4-Primitive Hardware Gesture Arena**: `18.7 s` · `4/4` first-try (Tap, Long-Press `823ms / 0px drift`, Drag, Pinch `1.63x`).
- **Android 16 `uid=2000` Background Virtual Display**: `24 ms` frame capture with live PiP inside Task Execution.

- **Zero-Voice-API Offline Neural ASR + TTS (Android 16 R8)**: `770 ms` Chinese streaming transcription (`streaming-zipformer-small-ctc-zh-int8`) + `573 ms` Chinese neural TTS (`vits-icefall-zh-aishell3`) with zero voice API key and zero Google Services.
- **One-Tap Live Screen Translate & Summary**: `4.5 s` reading 52 lines from active Virtual Display into a 2×2 Android 17 GenUI card.
- **Automated Test Suite**: `206 / 206` passed (`:sol-core:test` 93, `:app:testReleaseUnitTest` 75, Rust `cargo test` 38) + R8 + true 16KB uncompressed `.so`.
